{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Apricot recipes|Apricot]]

This is a very easy recipe made with only a few ingredients. The apricots can be served with chicken, pork or [[Cookbook:Turkish dolma pilav|Turkish dolma pilav]]. This should be enough for two people but it can easily be scaled up.

== Ingredients ==
*6–10+ dried [[Cookbook:Apricot|apricots]]
*About 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] water
*A generous handful of [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*[[Cookbook:Walnut|Walnuts]] (optional)

== Procedure ==
#Soak dried apricots in a large volume of water for around 10 minutes.
#Combine the 1 cup water and the sugar, and taste to adjust sweetness.
#Bring sugar mixture to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] and add apricots.
#[[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] until the liquid is reduced. The traditional consistency is close to a light syrup.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
*If reduced until it is a dark syrup it will be very hot and harden quickly, so plan accordingly.
*If serving as a dessert you can reduce to a light syrup and stuff or garnish with walnuts.
*This is good served with [[Cookbook:Turkish dolma pilav|Turkish dolma pilav]], or with a chicken or pork dish. It can also be served on its own with nuts as a dessert.
